UserAttributes.Name: MediaServiceConfiguration
UserAttributes.Label: Media Service Configuration
UserAttributes.Description: Media services must be placed on the home screen favorites row to be launched. Go to Home > Apps > App Settings to customize which services are on the home screen by selecting 'Add to Home'

UserAttributes.Name: Model Notice
UserAttributes.Label: Model Information
UserAttributes.Description: This driver supports the artwork and ambient mode commands.

UserAttributes.Name: Configuration Instructions
UserAttributes.Label: Warning Information
UserAttributes.Description: To configure for IP control, use TV remote and press Home button, navigate to Menu > Settings > All Settings > Connection > Network > Expert Settings, turn on "Power On with Mobile" and enable "IP Remote" settings. Then follow Enable Instructions

UserAttributes.Name: Configuration Instructions 2
UserAttributes.Label: Enable Instructions
UserAttributes.Description: To enable IP control, begin with TV powered on, then while driver is being loaded, look at TV for message to allow IP Remote control, use TV remote to select Allow, for control

UserAttributes.Name: Multiview Modes
UserAttributes.Label: Multiview Instructions
UserAttributes.Description: To be able to select saved Multiview modes via the driver's Custom Commands, the default names Samsung assigns to the Multiview modes must be kept. Do not rename the saved modes from the Samsung default names.

UserAttributes.Name: MacAddress
UserAttributes.Label: Mac Address
UserAttributes.Description: Use TV remote and press Home button, go to Menu > Settings > All Settings > Support > About TV. Then scroll to the Wired MAC Address setting. This is required to turn the Display on. Provide as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

UserAttributes.Name: WOLNotice
UserAttributes.Label: WOL Notice
UserAttributes.Description: Since this device uses Wake On LAN to power it on, the driver can have an extended warmup time where control may not be available for several tens of seconds. Please note this for this driver.

SupportedFeatures.Comment: The device doesn't tell us when a media service is active, so we have workarounds for that. Modify with care. Note that selecting media services via remote still can result in incorrect feedback since we can't know it happened.

Responses.Name: GetChannelDecoder
Responses.Comment: Only allow channel decoding for GetChannel responses. Responses to set commands like SetDigitalAirChannel always indicate that the command has succeeded yet a later GetChannel command will show it has not occurred yet. Hence the reason for those commands having PostCommandDelays
Setting access token to null so another GetAccessCommand is sent. This means the access token is stale and the Display no longer accepts it
Responses.Name: SetAccessTokenToNull

Map.discovery+: discovery+ | Stream TV Shows, Originals and More
Map.siriusxm: SiriusXM TV: Music, Podcasts, Sports, News
Map.slingtv: Sling TV: Live TV, Sports, News + Freestream
Map.viki: Viki: Asian Drama, Movies and More

Rules.Name: StartCoolDownWithCommand
Rules.Comment: This will fake feedback for cooldown and power feedback when turning the display off. After cooldown completes, the driver is not expecting any replies to Power.Get
When attempting to set the video input to unknown, send a harmless command that will be ack'ed
Rules.Name: DontSendUnknownInput

Controllers.Comment: Polling disabled since device still reports previous input while a media service is active
Controllers.Name: VideoInput

Controllers.Comment: Polling for what the display says the current input is occurs here. The intention is to set InputVideo to this if this value changes and the new value does not match VideoInput.
Controllers.Name: ReportedVideoInput
